senses.gloss:
f. (-या)
1 Censure, abuse.
2 Shame.
E.
हृणीङ्^1 to be ashamed, aff. यक्, and the vowel changed to रि; also हृणीया, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ashamed, modest, bashful.
2 Divided, portioned.
3 Taken, conveyed.
n. (-तं)
A portion, a share.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, क्त aff., and the vowel made short; or हृ to take, aff. क्त, and रि substituted for ऋ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ashamed, bashful, modest.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त, form reg.: see the last.

f. (-तिः)
Taking, conveying.
E.
रि substituted for ऋ: see हृति.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Being taken or seized.
2 Being captivated, attracted, &c.
E.
हृ to take, pass. v., शानच् aff.

n. (-रं)
A perfume.
E.
see ह्रीवेर.

n. (-रं)
A drug and perfume, commonly Bāla.
E.
ह्री shame, and वेर saffron.

r. 3rd cl. (जिह्रेति)
To be modest or ashamed.

f. (-ह्रीः)
Shame, bashfulness.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-का)
1 Modesty, shame.
2 Fear, terror.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कन्; also र changed to ल, ह्लीका.

mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु)
Ashamed, modest.
m. (-कुः)
1 Lac.
2 Tin.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कुक्; also ह्लीकु.

r. 1st cl. (ह्रीच्छति)
To be modest or ashamed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Modest, ashamed.
E.
ह्री shame, and जित overcome.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Ashamed.
E.
ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्तु, form irr.

m. (-सः)
Shamelessness.
E.
ह्री, and निरास throwing aff.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Bashful, modest, ashamed.
E.
ह्री, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-लं)
A perfume: see the last.
E.
ह्रीवेर as before, र changed to ल; also with कन् added, ह्रीवेलकं.
